definition: One God is numerical uniqueness of the God confessed by Dei Filius ch. 1. The case uses IsTheOneGod IsGod g := ∀ g′, IsGod g′ → g′ = g. This predicate alone does not assert IsGod g or the existence of any God; those are separate premises or conclusions.
note: The council confesses one existing God. The case predicate isolates its uniqueness content and does not conflate numerical uniqueness with every philosophical sense of unity.
